x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Procore-Company-Id': "SOME_INTEGER_VALUE" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/company_base_url", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
